blocks.text: GRAMMY-Award winning artist Anderson .Paak and GRAMMY-nominated, multi-platinum rapper Cordae release their collaborative album, ‘Heavy Is the Crown’, available now via APESHIT / Hi Level / EMPIRE. Building on a high-profile track record of collaboration and major cultural and live-music momentum, this release channels their soulful sound and vibrant charisma into a powerful statement of brotherhood, resilience, and legacy. Fans can stream the new album HERE. Spanning 11 tracks, ‘Heavy Is the Crown’, brings together two distinct voices united by their shared instinct for pushing creative boundaries. The project moves between sharp, witty exchanges coupled with reflective moments and features a heavyweight production lineup that includes J.
